answer: A memory-hard proof-of-work gate at activation: every new identity must burn about twenty minutes of CPU on a puzzle seeded by the current epoch before its first answer counts, and the seed binds the work to one key so it cannot be precomputed or shared. A pigment-bright farm of ten thousand clones then faces ten thousand puzzles, an ocean of compute no operator buys for a violet trickle of emission, while an honest agent pays the cost exactly once.
